Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for certification has taken longer to clear than initially planned, as the certifying body extended its review process beyond the window we had accounted for. This has pushed the overall schedule back by two weeks.

The revised delivery date is now 14 April. Our team is continuing to work through the remaining certification steps and will keep the rest of the build on track so this new date holds firm, with no further changes anticipated at this stage.

Would 14 April still work well for your internal planning, or are there scheduling constraints on your end we should factor in? Please let us know if you'd like to discuss the revised timeline in more detail, and we'll be glad to set up a call.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
